entries.title: Psalms 90:1
segments: ¶<<A Prayer of Moses, the man of God.>> Lord, *thou* hast been our dwelling-place in all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 90:2
segments: Before the mountains were brought forth, and thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from eternity to eternity thou art *God.

entries.title: Psalms 90:3
segments: Thou makest [mortal] man to return to dust, and sayest, Return, children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 90:4
segments: For a thousand years, in thy sight, are as yesterday when it is past, and [as] a watch in the night.

entries.title: Psalms 90:5
segments: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are [as] a sleep: in the morning they are like grass [that] groweth up:

entries.title: Psalms 90:6
segments: In the morning it flourisheth and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down and withereth.

entries.title: Psalms 90:7
segments: ¶For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy fury are we troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 90:8
segments: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret [sins] in the light of thy countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 90:9
segments: For all our days pass away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a [passing] thought.

entries.title: Psalms 90:10
segments: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if, by reason of strength, they be fourscore years, yet their pride is labour and vanity, for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

entries.title: Psalms 90:11
segments: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? and thy wrath according to the fear of thee?

entries.title: Psalms 90:12
segments: ¶So teach [us] to number our days, that we may acquire a wise heart.

entries.title: Psalms 90:13
segments: Return, Jehovah: how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

entries.title: Psalms 90:14
segments: Satisfy us early with thy loving-kindness; that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

entries.title: Psalms 90:15
segments: Make us glad according to the days [wherein] thou hast afflicted us, according to the years [wherein] we have seen evil.

entries.title: Psalms 90:16
segments: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy majesty unto their sons.

entries.title: Psalms 90:17
segments: And let the beauty of Jehovah our God be upon us; and establish thou the work of our hands upon us: yea, the work of our hands, establish thou it.
